CustomObject.description: Catalog of prompt/LLM-input strings localized by article language. Each record is one (Text_Key__c, Language_Code__c) pair. Resolved via KBLocalizedText.get(key, languageCode) with a two-level English fallback: a missing (key, language) pair falls back to the same key's English ('en') record, and a totally-absent key returns null (caller supplies its own default). Lets AI-Fix (and any future flow) send the model a directive written in the article's own language without a second translation call.
CustomObject.label: KB Localized Prompt Text
